title: Oxidation of TcO2 and UO2 by aqueous Mn(III)-citrate and Mn(III)-tartrate under anoxic conditions: implications for technetium and uranium fate and transport
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, 5,1106-1115
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00264H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zachary Murphy, Zachary Ronchetti, Cassandra Munoz, David Rai, Vasileios Anagnostopoulos
Mn(III)-citrate/tartrate complexes oxidize UO2 and TcO2 to soluble UO22+ and TcO4−. Electron exchange reduces Mn(III) to Mn(II), producing oxidized ligands and mobilized radionuclides.
